question: How much residual moisture did the water-processed NMC532 cathode lose between 20 °C and drying at 120 °C, and how does its final value compare with the NMP-processed cathode dried at 100 °C?

trace.query: SELECT id, page, text FROM lines WHERE page IN (8,9) AND (text ILIKE '%moisture%' OR text ILIKE '%ppm%' OR text ILIKE '%625%' OR text ILIKE '%47 ppm%') ORDER BY page, line_no
SELECT id, text, value, unit, role FROM measures WHERE id IN ('p8.L53:28#75','p8.L57:9#152','p8.L55:29#74','p8.L53:28#67','p8.L57:9#41')

SELECT (SELECT value FROM measures WHERE id='p8.L53:28#75') - (SELECT value FROM measures WHERE id='p8.L57:9#152') AS loss_ppm, (SELECT value FROM measures WHERE id='p8.L55:29#74') - (SELECT value FROM measures WHERE id='p8.L57:9#152') AS gap_ppm
